Name: Cute Chest Buckles - AT Version
Author: twilightdvsn
Description:
This mod replaces the vanilla chests (chest, big chest, stone chest, big stone chest) with versions that have either a pink heart or yellow moon buckle.

This is an Alternative Textures version of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22280]Cute Chest Buckles[/url] mod that uses Content Patcher. Therefore, you must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] downloaded for this version to work!

As of now, Alternative Textures does NOT support the recolor of chests. If you usually change the color of your chests, whether it be for organizing or aesthetics, you'll have to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22280]Content Patcher version[/url]. The color of the wood for the regular and big chests have been toned down.

In the future I might add in recolors for the chests, but as of right now there will only be the base wooden and stone colors.


I know I am a small mod creator and don't make anything extravagant, but this year has been very hard for my mental and physical health, resulting in me being unemployed for the past couple months/indefinite future. My student loan debt has been crippling for someone not making money, so if you enjoy my mod(s) enough and have anything to spare, it would make a world of a difference for me. Otherwise, please enjoy using my mod guilt-free and thank you for downloading!

For those interested, here is my [url=https://ko-fi.com/twilightdvsn]ko-fi <3[/url]
